build_cutmixup_transform: build a data transform that applies cutmix and mixup augmentation to a batch of images
create_mixup_instance: create a Mixup instance with custom alpha values and label smoothing for training data augmentation
apply_cutmix_bbox: apply cutmix bounding box augmentation to randomly replace a region of an image with another sample
generate_mixup_target: generate a mixed one-hot encoded target tensor with label smoothing for mixed training samples
review_recursive_mixup: review the recursive mixup function that mixes sample data across nested lists, tuples, and dictionaries
